name: Machine Seated Close-Grip Row
steps: Sit facing the pad with both feet on the footplates and grasp the narrow parallel handles.
Keep your chest against the pad and let your shoulder blades slide forward as your arms extend.
Pull both handles straight back along your sides by driving your elbows close to your ribs and squeezing your lats and mid-back.
Extend your arms slowly back to the starting position without letting the weight stack bang.
tips: Keep your chest anchored to the pad instead of leaning backward as you row.
Keep your shoulders pulled down away from your ears throughout the movement.
